title: Bears & Beers Tasting Tour out of Anchorage
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Alaska's stunning wildlife and natural beauty on this immersive tour. Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center to see bears and other native animals, then journey through the scenic Portage Glacier area with high hanging glaciers , perfect for capturing breathtaking photos and, during certain seasons, witnessing the salmon spawn. Afterward, relax in Girdwood with a local brewery tour and tasting at the base of Alyeska Ski Resort. At the brewery they have some great food trucks. Seasonal highlights may include spotting Beluga whales or the captivating Bore Tide. 

- Wildlife viewing at Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center
- Scenic drive through Portage Glacier with photo stops
- Brewery tour and tasting included (staff permitting)must have an ID for alcohol.
- Snacks and water provided in the van, with hotel pick-up in Anchorage
